intent: Increase body width and wheel track to 0.18 for better stability and control; increase base speed to 0.6 for improved responsiveness.
rationale: The telemetry data indicates a high number of line loss events (2 in the first trial and 1 in the second), suggesting that the robot struggles with maintaining its path. To improve stability and control, I will increase the body width and wheel track to 0.18, which should enhance the robot's ability to follow the track. Additionally, I will increase the base speed to 0.6 to improve responsiveness, as the current speed may be contributing to the line loss events. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events and improve overall performance in the next trials.
